description: With hi-chart Reporting Studio for Power BI, all important graphics for clear and easy-to-understand reports, presentations and dashboards can be implemented in a single visual. Clear thanks to a built-in notation concept, graphic perfection and highlighting that directs the viewer's gaze. Easy thanks to drag-and-drop operation, wizards, automatic classification of data according to business meaning, and default settings that can be adjusted at any time. Efficient thanks to automatically suggested chart types that create very high quality graphics in seconds, and to automatically calculated variances. All charts and tables are built dynamically from the data structures and adapt to changes as they occur. Each automatism can be customised to your own needs with user-defined settings. The chart elements can be combined in almost any way to achieve the most suitable result. For instance, variance charts can be added to charts as well as to tables. The visualisation types can be changed subsequently as desired, so there's nothing to limit your ideas as you design your graphic. For example, you can switch between charts and tables, table columns and chart columns, base values, delta variances and percentage variances, grouped, stacked and individual columns, bars and areas, single charts and small multiples, normal and waterfall visualisations, as well as columns/bars, point-lines,…
